name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  lint-workflows:
    name: Lint workflows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Lint workflows
        uses: rhysd/actionlint@914e7df21a07ef503a81201c76d2b11c789d3fca # v1.7.12

  check:
    name: Node ${{ matrix.node }} check (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node:
          - "22.23.4"
          - "24.22.1"
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - xcode-27
          - windows-latest
        include:
          - node: "26.12.1"
            os: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@73e46992e05b19abd31f2f3c20e0e7370d762115 # v6.1.1
        with:
          version: 11.28.6
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Check
        run: pnpm check

      - name: Report coverage
        if: matrix.node == '24.22.1' && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: pnpm test:coverage

  browser-smoke:
    name: Ghostty browser smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@73e46992e05b19abd31f2f3c20e0e7370d762115 # v6.1.1
        with:
          version: 11.28.6
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.22.1
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Chromium
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run Ghostty browser smoke
        run: pnpm test:browser

name: Stale

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 4 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Mark inactive issues and pull requests
        uses: actions/stale@4391f3da665fdf50b6810c1a66712fb9ba21aa93 # v11.0.0
        with:
          days-before-issue-stale: 30
          days-before-issue-close: 14
          days-before-pr-stale: 30
          days-before-pr-close: 14
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-pr-label: stale
          exempt-issue-labels: security,pinned,no-stale,maintainer
          exempt-pr-labels: security,pinned,no-stale,maintainer
          exempt-all-assignees: true
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
          operations-per-run: 100
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked stale after 30 days without activity.
            Add current reproduction details or context to keep it open.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked stale after 30 days without activity.
            Rebase and add a current status update to keep it open.
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing due to inactivity. Open a new issue with fresh reproduction details if this still affects the latest release.
          close-issue-reason: not_planned
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing due to inactivity. A focused replacement pull request is welcome when the work is ready to resume.

name: CodeQL

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  schedule:
    - cron: "31 5 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: codeql-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.run_id || github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze ${{ matrix.language }}
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language:
          - javascript-typescript
          - actions
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@33d7b85da1a04171e211befe2c739303b9a4c066 # v4.39.3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@33d7b85da1a04171e211befe2c739303b9a4c066 # v4.39.3
        with:
          category: /language:${{ matrix.language }}

self-hosted-runner:
  labels:
    - xcode-27
    - crabbox
    - openclaw
    - libterminal

# @openclaw/libterminal

TypeScript primitives for terminal protocols, streaming, rendering, and WebSocket
bridges across browsers, Node.js, and Cloudflare Workers.

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @openclaw/libterminal
```

The Node.js adapters require Node.js `^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0`.
For Ghostty rendering or Node-hosted Ghostty assets, install the pinned optional peer:

```sh
pnpm add ghostty-web@0.4.0
```

Stream and protocol consumers do not need a renderer. The self-contained
`/worker-assets` export retains its embedded assets and also needs no peer.

Install the optional PTY driver when using `spawnLocalPty()`:

```sh
pnpm add node-pty
```

## Exports

Import the entry point for your runtime. Browser and Worker entry points do not
import Node.js built-ins. Subpaths below extend `@openclaw/libterminal`.

| Entry point             | Provides                                       |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `@openclaw/libterminal` | Shared terminal types and errors               |
| `/protocol`             | Protocol v2 codecs and validation              |
| `/stream`               | Bounded replay, fanout, and batching           |
| `/browser`              | Ghostty WASM terminals and terminal hub client |
| `/node`                 | Local PTYs, raw stdio, and Ghostty assets      |
| `/worker`               | WebSocket bridging and control checks          |
| `/worker-assets`        | Embedded Ghostty assets and HTTP responses     |
| `/testing`              | Deterministic terminal test doubles            |

For example:

```ts
import { decodeTerminalFrame } from "@openclaw/libterminal/protocol";
import { BoundedReplayBuffer } from "@openclaw/libterminal/stream";
```

## Streaming

Replay buffers, fanout subscriptions, and batch publishers copy incoming bytes.
Queues are bounded. See [streaming and byte ownership](docs/usage.md#streaming).

## Browser

Create a read-only Ghostty terminal or connect a multiplexed terminal WebSocket.
See [browser integration](docs/usage.md#browser) for assets, cancellation, and color queries.

## Node.js

Spawn a local PTY, attach stdio, or serve Ghostty assets.
See [Node.js integration](docs/usage.md#nodejs) for setup and teardown behavior.

## Workers

Bridge authenticated WebSockets or serve embedded Ghostty assets.
See [Worker integration](docs/usage.md#workers) for control checks and asset routes.

## Protocol

Wire-protocol versions and package versions are independent.
See [protocol compatibility](docs/usage.md#protocol) and the
[protocol v2 specification](protocol/terminal-v2.json).

## Safety

Applications own authentication, authorization, public listeners, storage, and
transcripts. The package does not log or persist terminal bytes.
See the [integration boundaries](docs/usage.md#safety) and [security policy](https://github.com/openclaw/libterminal/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## Development

Use the pinned pnpm version and a supported development runtime.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/openclaw/libterminal/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, validation, review, and release steps.
The [Ghostty validation guide](docs/ghostty-upgrade.md) explains browser e2e coverage
and performance measurements.
